subject.name: Slack

territories.name: The channel
territories.description: A busy shared workspace kept friendly: aubergine, white and four bright accents around plain conversation.

rationale.grounding.primary: Inferred, not stated by the source. Departs from Bauhaus outlines and square corners: Slack's forms are rounded.
rationale.type.faces: Stand-ins. Larsseit and Circular (SL27, SL28) are outside the catalogue; Work Sans and Manrope are the closest in kind.
rationale.type.character.type-scale: four descending bold headings over body (SL29)
rationale.adaptivity: white, black and aubergine grounds all carry the logo (SL20)
